social_circle.name: Gina Romano

demographics.occupation: project coordinator for a healthcare nonprofit

background.how_they_met: Gina is John's younger sister; they grew up together in north Columbus/Worthington with their parents.
background.why_close: They share family history, practical responsibility for their parents, and a low-drama sibling bond built around texting, jokes, and helping each other.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Fast, casual texter who mixes practical reminders with memes, photos of Luca, and direct emotional check-ins. Uses emojis lightly and prefers short bursts over long phone calls.

shared_activities: family dinners at their parents' house
coordinating help for Anthony and Maria
recent_text_topics: Coordinating who will help their parents with portal passwords, insurance forms, and appointment logistics.
Sharing Luca updates, photos, and jokes about John being the uncle who brings science kits.
Planning Sunday lasagna dinners, birthdays, and family holiday schedules.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Gina is John's younger sister, lives in Westerville, and they are close but communicate through 'texts, memes, and practical favors.' Q17 says John tries to check in with his sister once a week. Q35 says Gina handles emotional check-ins while John handles tech, paperwork, and transportation.

social_circle.name: Marcus Bennett

demographics.occupation: operations manager for a logistics company

background.how_they_met: John met Marcus through pickup basketball in Columbus.
background.why_close: Their friendship is built on weekly basketball, Cavs games, coffee, candid work-stress conversations, and enough trust for Marcus to talk openly about race and policing.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in short, plainspoken bursts, often with basketball trash talk, Cavs reactions, and direct questions. Not overly polished, but steady and emotionally useful.

shared_activities: coffee or diner runs after Sunday games
recent_text_topics: Confirming pickup basketball times and checking whether John's ankle feels solid enough after past soreness.
Reacting to Cavs games, matchups, and Reddit-style fan takes.
Talking through John's sales pressure and Marcus's own work stress in a blunt but supportive way.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 says Marcus is probably John's closest friend, that they met playing pickup basketball, and that they usually play or grab coffee once a week. Q07 also says they watch Cavs games and talk through work stress. Q26 and Q30 show Marcus is close enough to shape John's thinking about race and policing through personal stories.

social_circle.name: Leah Kaplan

demographics.occupation: sales manager at a B2B technology company

background.how_they_met: Leah and John met at work as peer managers in the same B2B technology sales organization.
background.why_close: They became close through intense quarter-end pushes, honest peer feedback, and mutual trust that extends beyond ordinary work communication.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Uses complete sentences, dry humor, and direct check-ins. She will call out John's spiral without cushioning it too much, but follows up with practical support.

shared_activities: coffee before or after office days
personal support texts when stress spikes
recent_text_topics: John trying not to let forecast pressure spill onto his team.
Comparing notes on newer reps who need more in-person coaching.
Joking about quarter-end caffeine levels and whether John is overchecking Salesforce again.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 says John is close with coworker Leah because they have been through intense quarter-end pushes together. Q44 shows Leah gave him kind but direct feedback after a lost deal. Q45 says Leah notices when John is anxious, and Q49 names Leah as one of the people he would text first when struggling.

social_circle.name: Maria Papagno

demographics.occupation: retired elementary teacher and reading-support educator

background.how_they_met: Maria is John's mother and raised him in a middle-class Italian-American family in Columbus.
background.why_close: She shaped John's love of museums, music, cooking, and family traditions; he still sees her often and attends family meals and holidays.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Warm, slightly wordy texter who asks if John has eaten, sends family reminders, and uses affectionate punctuation. More likely than John to send a follow-up if he does not answer.

shared_activities: Christmas or Easter Mass with family
recent_text_topics: Inviting John over for lasagna or asking what he can bring to Sunday dinner.
Checking on his stress, sleep, and whether he is eating real meals during busy sales weeks.
Family plans around holidays, birthdays, and Maria's continued knee-replacement recovery routines.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q01 describes John's mother starting Sunday sauce and shaping his creative interests through museums and music. Q05 says his parents Anthony and Maria are core people and still ask if he is eating enough. Q35 says Maria had knee replacement surgery and John helped with rides, groceries, and patient portal messages. Q47 says he still goes to Mass on Christmas or Easter because it matters to his mom.

social_circle.name: Anthony Papagno

demographics.occupation: retired operations manager for an HVAC and building systems distributor

background.how_they_met: Anthony is John's father and raised him in Columbus with Maria.
background.why_close: They connect through practical problem-solving, money and house advice, sports, and John's role helping him navigate technology, insurance, and health paperwork.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Brief and utilitarian texter. Sends direct questions, links to paperwork, appointment times, and occasional sports comments. Less emotionally expressive than Maria but dependable.

shared_activities: practical advice about money, cars, and housing
recent_text_topics: Questions about blood pressure or cholesterol paperwork and whether a medical bill looks right.
Sending John links or screenshots when a website, streaming app, or portal password is not working.
Talking about housing prices, interest rates, and whether John should keep renting or eventually buy.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 names Anthony as John's father and says John helps his parents with tech, appointments, and paperwork. Q06 says John calls his dad for practical money or house advice. Q35 says his dad has blood pressure and cholesterol issues. Q100 and Q106 describe Anthony's bachelor's degree in business and operations-manager background, which John connects to his own 'spreadsheet brain.'
